title: Jewel Mirror Samadhi Part 2
speaker: Kanho Chris Burkhart
summary: The teacher encourages listeners to approach spiritual understanding not through intellectual analysis, but by directly experiencing and noticing reality as it is, rather than trying to grasp a specific concept or definition. This "noticing" approach seeks to transcend our usual tendency to see things in contrast and labels, instead revealing the interconnectedness of all phenomena. By embracing this direct recognition, listeners can begin to see their own experience and the world around them in a new light, dissolving the boundaries between self and other.

In the third watch of the night, before the moon appears,
*no wonder when we meet there is no recognition.
Still cherished in my heart is the beauty of earlier days.
A sleepy-eyed grandma encounters herself in an old mirror.
Clearly she sees a face, but it doesn't resemble her at all.
Too bad, with a muddled head, she tries to recognize her reflection.
Within nothingness there is a path, leading away from the dusts of the world.
